title: zostera muelleri subsp. novazelandica
intro: Zostera muelleri subsp. novazelandica, commonly known as New Zealand eelgrass, is a subspecies of marine flowering plant in the family Zosteraceae. It is a type of seagrass that grows in coastal waters, particularly in New Zealand. The health benefits of Zostera muelleri subsp. novazelandica include its potential to alleviate inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
